question.text: Light of wavelength $180 \mathrm{nm}$ ejects photoelectron from a plate of a metal whose work function is $2 \mathrm{eV}$. If a uniform magnetic field of $5 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~T}$ is applied parallel to plate, what would be theradius of the path followed by electrons ejected normally from the plate with maximum energy?
